metadata.short_desc: Detect message flooding and mute automatically; global + per-group thresholds and custom notice text
metadata.desc: Automatically mutes users who exceed the message threshold. Thresholds, window, mute duration and the notice template can be configured from the plugin page, or overridden per group in QQ via the /刷屏 commands.

window_seconds.hint: Messages are counted within this time window

max_messages.description: Messages within the window that trigger a mute

mute_seconds.hint: 0 means only count and notify, no real mute

cooldown_seconds.hint: Avoid repeated mutes in a short time

notify.description: Send a notice in the group when triggered
